## About
North Hills Plumbing is a family owned plumbing company on Rufe Snow Drive in North Richland Hills. We've been family owned from the start, and we work for homeowners and businesses in Dallas, Fort Worth and the cities around them.
Ron Benefiel is our master plumber and the founder of North Hills Plumbing. Our plumbers are licensed by the State of Texas and know both the state and city plumbing codes. They take the time to explain what they find in plain English, offer solutions and give you a clear estimate before the work starts.
Neighbors have given us a 4.6 rating across 75 Google reviews. Read what they have to say and decide for yourself if we're the right plumber for your home.

## Services
- Slab leak detection: Think you have a leak under your slab? We find it and fix it.
- Cast iron pipe repair: We repair and replace cast iron pipe. One reviewer said Vance and Marcus communicated with them along the way on their job.
- Water heaters: Installation and repair for gas and electric tank water heaters, plus tankless units.
- Kitchen and bathroom remodels: Toilets, showers, faucets, sink aerators, washer connections and water lines for your remodel.
- Commercial plumbing: We work as a commercial plumbing contractor for restaurants, office buildings, apartments and other businesses.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're based in North Richland Hills and work across the surrounding area, including Keller, Watauga, Hurst, Bedford, Fort Worth and Dallas.

Q: Are your plumbers licensed?
A: Yes. All of our plumbers have passed state plumbing examinations and are licensed by the State of Texas.

Q: Do you work with home insurance companies?
A: Yes. Along with homeowners, we serve numerous home insurance companies, and our website has an insurance adjuster form.

Q: How do I schedule service?
A: Fill out the request form or call (817) 485-3413 and a representative will help you set up a time.
